environment: Headless Chrome 156 over CDP on this Mac, --use-angle=swiftshader (software WebGL). Pages served from http://127.0.0.1:8781. Scripts: scratchpad cdp/checks.mjs, shots.mjs, followup.mjs, contrastrun.mjs.

scale.method: fireMeteor(37.7946,-122.3999,500), sample 540 ms in at pitch 0 (same timing as the harness), fx ring radius = fxRingRadiusPx(), overlay = fxRingRadiusPx(true); 2x +/-3% and +/-2 px

scale_note: fxRingRadiusPx() projects the fx ring's own centre and metre radius through map.project; it is not a pixel measurement of the drawn ring.

lifecycle.note: fx layer counted via the live map instance (captured by an injected test-only script wrapping maplibregl.Map.prototype.addLayer), because counts().fx_layers reads map.getStyle(), which never lists the custom fx layer (it stays 0 even while getLayer("fx") exists)

hidden_tab.note: document.hidden achieved via Target.createTarget + activateTarget (second tab foreground)

no_damage_stomp.why: way is on no baseline trip path (edge_way over trip_path_edges), so deleting it cannot change any shortest path

layout.note: All non-empty raw lists are in the meteor+details-open state below 900 px: road rows inside the scrolling details area intersect the weapon dock by bounding box. With each rect clipped by its overflow ancestors (scratchpad cdp/clipcheck.js) the visible intersection count is 0 at the top and after scrolling details to the bottom, in every viewport; the screenshots show the rows clipped above the dock. The raw script does not model scroll clipping.

stomp_locations.sentence: No sampled trip used Bonita Avenue

result_sentence_once.note: innerText count 2 for the no-damage Stomp comes from #status (0x0, not visible) or the sr-only #announcement live region; it is drawn once (.message in #results).

contrast.script: scratchpad/contrast_check.js variant returning min ratio (cdp/contrast_min.js); composites element/ancestor background colors over --bg, not the map pixels behind translucent surfaces
